notes.title: First pass on Controller support
notes.content:
The newest build of Damned Cold comes with controller support. It's been tested using Windows 7 64bit with a xbox 360 wired controller. The patch also comes with a few minor bug fixes. 

*Disclaimer* There was a bug using DS4Windows and a DS4 controller that caused a hang using the Steam Overlay. We're looking into it.
